pinnedState.definition: Bounded reachable logical payloads under named roots; not total retained heap/native bytes.

inventory.definition: Serial PSS observations of the named process and bounded descendant tree; not cgroup memory or an atomic service total.
inventory.lifetimeDefinition: Not observed is not proof of exit. Roles identify executable/entry only, not retained allocation owners or HTTP routing.

metricDefinitions.heapAndNative: V8/Node counters, overlapping with PSS; no additive native-residual estimate
metricDefinitions.heapSpaces: V8 getHeapSpaceStatistics per-space bytes; space membership can change across GC
metricDefinitions.heapCode: V8 getHeapCodeStatistics bytes; code/source counters overlap heap/external and do not identify retainers
metricDefinitions.pinnedState: Reachable logical payloads under named roots; not total retained heap/native bytes
metricDefinitions.observerMs: wall time for inspector counter read and proc descendant census

limitations: Counters cover one explicitly selected main/descendant PID; HTTP request assignment remains unknown.
Ambient workload is uncontrolled; idle means no probe HTTP requests.
No paired intervention, allocation profiler, retainer graph or physical-savings claim.
Current disk bundle hash is recorded separately from the health-reported loaded build.
